name: B10-0262/2026 (Renew) – Repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking the European Union and its member states to act on Iran. It asks them to widen sanctions on Iranian officials tied to repression, including judges, prison officials and the Revolutionary Guard, and on their family members' assets in Europe. It also calls for the release of political prisoners, an end to executions, and United Nations action to hold those responsible to account.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests, not decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Iranian officials under sanctions, their families in the EU, and Iran's diplomatic missions.
- **What happens next:** EU governments decide whether to impose the sanctions and other measures.
